exposure: Four latent classes of women with IDD: (1) young, mostly healthy, little primary care before pregnancy; (2) older, mostly healthy; (3) young to mid-aged, significant comorbidities; (4) young, many autistic, medical and psychiatric comorbidities
cohort: Pregnant women with (n = 1922) and without (n = 1,126,854) IDD, with a singleton birth in Ontario, Canada, from 2003 to 2018
finding: Women with IDD and significant comorbidities had the greatest risks of perinatal complications compared to women without IDD, highlighting the need for tailored multidisciplinary care.
